notes: Recorded 23 bachelor's, 53 master's and 47 doctoral rows (one row per major per university; some majors repeat across universities and levels). Universities read in full: Tianjin, Nankai, China Pharmaceutical, Central South, Beijing Foreign Studies, Shaanxi Normal, Changsha University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Sun Yat-sen, Yangtze, Shanghai International Studies, Nanjing Forestry, Zhejiang University of Science and Technology, Beihang, Southwest, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Qingdao, Nanchang, Jinan, China Three Gorges, Tongji, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics.

No official list of all participating universities was found; many more universities run Silk Road places each year. The rows are the full lists of the universities named above only, not of the whole programme. Each university states the exact list of its own call.

The earlier file held HUST master's and doctoral rows (Computer Science and Technology, Civil Engineering, Chemistry) 'carried over from stored data'; the HUST 2026 guide read now lists undergraduate programmes only (Software Engineering, Architecture), so those master's and doctoral rows are not repeated here as they are not confirmed by the notice.

Tianjin University and China Pharmaceutical University publish their catalogues as images; both images were opened and read in full (Tianjin: 5 majors, CPU: 4 bachelor, 3 master, 3 doctoral combinations).

Chinese-only names: Jinan University (3 undergraduate programmes) and the Chinese-taught Southwest University list give no English names, so the original is kept. Shanghai International Studies University's names are from its bilingual page. Majors repeated at both master's and doctoral level are listed once per level.

Harbin Engineering University's 2026 notice names five fields for its Smart Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering programme (Naval Architecture and Ocean Structure Design and Manufacturing; Control Science and Engineering; Power Engineering and Engineering Thermophysics; Information and Communication Engineering; Mechanics) but not the levels, so they are not entered as rows.
Several universities state their list is 'for reference' and subject to China Scholarship Council approval.
not_stated: A national list of Silk Road majors or participating universities.
Level and teaching language for some programmes (Yangtze University, Harbin Engineering University, Nanchang University, Shanghai International Studies University).
fetch_problems: Chongqing University and Nanjing Normal University notices answer with a browser check (HTTP 412); not bypassed, so their lists are not recorded.

Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine, Nanjing University, Southwest Jiaotong University, Liaoning University, Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology, China University of Mining and Technology, Guizhou University, Anhui Agricultural University and other universities' 2026 pages were found but not readable or were 404/removed or older-year (2025/2026) notices, so they are not recorded.
Huazhong University of Science and Technology page was unreachable by the page fetch tool and was read by direct download.
